content: {"phoneNote":"Strong, trade-specific hero with the licence-plate phone number, but \"Navodila za pot\" appears three times in the first two screens (header, hero, yellow info band) and the yellow band repeats what the hero already says.","desktopNote":"The hero is confident and well composed, but the 2012/specialization section leaves the left half mostly empty, the services grid has a dead lower-right quadrant and the process section is a narrow column with half the width unused.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":5},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":3,"spacing":2,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":5},"fixes":["Remove duplicate 'Navodila za pot' links (header + hero + info band) and keep one directions link plus one phone action per screen; merge the hero and yellow info band.","On desktop, fill the empty halves: pair the services list and process steps with a workshop photo or move the 2012 figure beside the specialization text at a proportionate size.","Add a second photo (workshop, master, cars) in the specialization or process section so the page below the hero isn't pure text; shorten the vertical padding of the grey services band."],"blockers":[]}
